justification: Migration 059 seeds cdc_eligibility_standards with the three Housing Code standards the CDC engine reads (zones, min lot, acid-sulfate class), every row quote-cited to regulatory_provisions ids. Rows land manual_verified=false and the engine reads verified rows only, so nothing renders from this seed until founder review. Standard tier because the content is regulatory data destined for a paid report, even though the diff is one SQL file.

pre_impl.existing_data: Values grounded in the ingested Codes SEPP corpus this session: cl 3.1(3) Lot requirements (regulatory_provisions ids 36996/36997) supplies the zone set R1-R4+RU5 and the flat 200 m2 minimum; cl 1.19(1)(c) (ids 36184/36185) supplies the acid-sulfate exclusion at Class 1 or 2. Verified live that load_cdc_standards returns None with these unverified rows present.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: Three corrections against the workbench route's TS hardcodes emerged from grounding: acid-sulfate exclusion is Class 1-2 not Class <=3 (the route over-excluded Class 3 land); B1/B2 are ungrounded for the Housing Code and are not seeded; the conditional 200 m2 wording (cl 6.4(1)(d)(ii)) belongs to a different code, so the Housing Code minimum carries NULL conditionality.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: Data-only insert into the table created by migration 058; no code changes. ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING makes re-runs safe; the one-active partial unique index prevents duplicate actives.
